verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his empowered Q before level 6; you win once Black Cleaver and R are both online past level 11.

brief.thesis: Yorick's Q (Last Rites) gives him a self-heal plus bonus damage on his next auto, and his W (Dark Procession) wall lets him zone or vanish from bad trades — that's why he holds lane advantage and the solo-kill edge. Urgot has no early answer to that sustain, but his ranged poke, Echoing Flames procs, and itemized bruiser scaling close the gap hard, which is why the head-to-head still sits at a near-coinflip 49.8% over 818 games.

theirWindow.when: Q up and a wave is crashing
theirWindow.what: He's about to land an empowered, healing auto and can dig a grave off the minion he kills for a Mist Walker. Don't contest that wave in melee range — let him have the grave rather than eating the free trade.

yourWindow.what: Disdain stops on him and hurls him out of position — immediately fire R (Fear Beyond Death); per the matchup data this combo takes easy kills once R is live at level 6.

start.why: Measured at 50.5% over 810 games and the 79.7% pick for this lane — you need the sustain and early damage to survive Last Rites all-ins, not just mana or armor.

boots.why: 50.8% over 632 games and the 65.5% pick; cuts down his empowered Q autos and Mist Walker chip damage, which is where most of his early lane pressure comes from.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (52.3% over 107 games); the stacking armor shred compounds with Echoing Flames procs to turn your autos into real DPS against his melee frame.
Same path; the bonus health and tenacity let you stand in Mourning Mist's slow and armor shred instead of getting kited or walled off.
Closes out the 52.3% core — stacking resistances let you tank Mist Walker swarms late and keep threatening R without dying to a counter-all-in.

runes.keystoneWhy: He's a low-mobility melee champion you can poke into range of — stacking 3 hits before he disengages behind a wall triggers the vulnerable debuff and turns your sustained trading into real burst.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the highest-measured combo here at 57.3% — it answers Yorick's identity as a wall-assisted sidelane splitpusher better than Ignite's early kill pressure, which matters more given he holds the early solo-kill edge anyway.

playing.title: Dodge empowered Q autos
playing.detail: Last Rites gives him bonus damage and a heal on his next auto — back off to Purge range or bait it onto a minion instead of your HP bar whenever his Q is up.

playing.title: Poke before he closes
playing.detail: Open trades with Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range) while he's still outside his own attack range — you outrange him until he lands a hit.

playing.title: Hold W for locked-in fights
playing.detail: Purge prioritizes champions you've already struck and slows you while channeling, so only commit it after Q or E has already tagged him, not as an opener.

playing.title: Don't chase into a fresh wall
playing.detail: When he drops W (Dark Procession) to disengage, reset and keep poking with Q instead of burning your own cooldowns walking around his wall.

playing.title: Combo E into R
playing.detail: Once E (Disdain) catches him and throws him out of position, immediately cast R (Fear Beyond Death) for the execute — this is the measured kill pattern once R is live at 6.

playing.title: Respect levels 1-5
playing.detail: Last Rites sustain and Mourning Mist's armor shred mean he wins straight fights early — play for poke and wave state, not extended trades, until your items come online.

playing.title: Itemize into Black Cleaver first
playing.detail: The armor shred stacks with Echoing Flames to finally out-damage his melee kit — this is the single biggest lever that flips the matchup past level 11.

brief.patchCaveat: The win rates, build order, rune pages, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability interactions, timing windows, and trade calls are my own read of the kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [P] during early game to apply pressure in lane. If [E] lands successfully, follow up with [R] to get a kill easily.
